Household & cash assumptions

Public version: household cash, income, living expenses, rent and moving costs start at $0. Enter your own values for meaningful budget and funding results. Keep existing car costs inside your existing spending. Account for final rent once, in your budget or transition costs. Earnest money is part of purchase cash, not an extra expense.

401(k) loan & optional additional car

401(k) rate and term are editable illustrations, not Principal plan terms. Required borrowing is not proof of eligibility or approval. Estimated repayment is monthly equivalent; payroll may collect it weekly. Confirm fees, maximum borrowing and timing with Principal. Add repayment only once to take-home pay.

Default: share one EV, so no extra car payment or insurance. Commute, tolls, charging and utility changes are unpriced until entered below each home. Darden charging is free; Ravago EV charging is at home. Solar savings are not assumed.

Compare on equal assumptions

All homes start with taxes modeled at 1.8% of your offer per year and homeowners insurance at 1% of the mortgage per year. These are planning allowances, not quotes or official buyer tax estimates. Edit either home after you get actual figures. Separate CDD costs have not been verified; enter all assessments once in the tax total.

Closing costs default to a fixed $17,000 per home, including prepaid homeowners insurance and initial escrow, based on the earlier Chalfont worksheet. This allowance does not automatically change with price, financing or closing date. Replace it with each lender's itemized estimate; inspection and agent fees are separate.

The usual $5,000 seller credit and 2.5% seller-paid buyer-agent compensation are negotiation assumptions, not agreed contributions. West Amelia uses its advertised $10,000 closing credit; Each property override is editable and must be confirmed in a signed agreement. The remaining commission assumes your buyer agreement requires 3%; the $499 broker fee needs confirmation. No grant, lender credit or FHA upfront premium is assumed. PMI is estimated using illustrative pricing; no automatic PMI cancellation is assumed.

Monthly balance includes housing, maintenance, any entered pool service allowance, optional extra principal, 401(k) repayment and entered incremental transport/utilities. It excludes any other unentered costs. A positive balance alone does not confirm affordability.

Listing photos are embedded for reliable offline viewing. Photos © respective listing providers, sourced via Zillow, Redfin and respective listing providers. Listing claims checked November 13–14, 2026; property facts, dues, taxes and availability require confirmation.
